text: Steenbarger: no, the ACT_NOW camp does not share one entry. Minervini and livermore want close_above:pivot_high on D, elder-lens in_zone:entry; the slate trigger is carried by raschke, seow and me. On my method D close_vs_swing_high_pct -4.04 is the pullback into a trading zone, the C7 last-point-of-support entry; a pivot clear buys further from value. h1_close_above:bar_high is the C12 buy stop that demands follow-through after H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 89.9. I hold it. Wrong if a daily close below base_low_20d. Count ADVANCE only on seats who accept this trigger.
